items.title: validate_deck and swu_analyze disagree on leader/base structure
items.scope: One Deck/CardIndex model shared by both CLIs. Enforce exactly one leader and one base, the correct slot type, no leader/base in the sideboard, and reject secondleader in Premier.
acceptance: 4/4 differential cases agree between validate_deck and swu_analyze
A regression test fails before the fix and passes after it
No new P0/P1 and no regression in the Poggle case
items.notes: Pilot for the factory loop. Freeze expected values before implementation; the agent may implement and run the oracle, but must not author the expected verdicts.

items.title: Legality must fail closed when suspension data is missing or empty
items.scope: Missing, empty or truncated suspension data must block legality or union the built-in registry. It must never silently pass every card.
acceptance: An empty Premier suspension snapshot is a blocking limitation
A regression test covers the empty and truncated cases
No new P0/P1
items.notes: On main, suspension is not implemented; this may be a port from dynamic-legal-set-check rather than a small patch.
